statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness consistent with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The diagnosis codes are I48.91 and I48.0
The procedure code is CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring)
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization before the service was rendered
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is medically necessary to capture arrhythmic episodes and guide further management
